name: Focus timer
description: One focus timer for every workspace: its time left in the status bar and on the panel's tab, and a notification when it's up. Plugin code keeps the timer; the page and a status item show it.

settings.title: Minutes
settings.description: How long a focus session lasts.

statusItems.label: Focus timer
statusItems.command:
f="$HOME/.cache/komla-focus-timer"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; read state a b < "$f"; now=$(date +%s); case "$state" in running) left=$((a - now)); [ "$left" -lt 0 ] && left=0; printf '\357\200\227 %dm
Focus: %d:%02d left. Click to pause or reset it.
' $(((left + 59) / 60)) $((left / 60)) $((left % 60)) ;; paused) printf '\357\201\214 %dm
Focus timer paused. Click to resume it.
' $(((a + 59) / 60)) ;; done) [ $((now - a)) -lt 300 ] && printf '\357\200\214 Break
Focus time is up. Take a break.
' ;; esac; exit 0
